fieldList.$description: FieldList's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--field-list-<name>) on the page, a container or one FieldList, and every FieldList inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

label-color.$description: The legend, the list's name (4.5:1 on the surface).

hint-color.$description: The hint under the legend and the note beside Add at the limit (4.5:1 on the surface).

error-color.$description: A row's error and the list's error (4.5:1 on the surface).

gap.$description: Space between the legend, the rows and Add (12px).

row-gap.$description: Space between the fields of a row, and before its Remove button (12px).

error-gap.$description: Space between an error's icon and its words (4px).

field-min-width.$description: The narrowest a field gets before a row's fields wrap onto more lines (160px).
